subject: french
general_outcomes: By the end of Junior School, the learner should be able to;
develop the ability to use the language for purposes of practical communication;
appreciate the culture of other people to promote national and international relationship for peaceful co-existence
contribute to the cognitive and affective development of the student;
promote positive attitudes and develop an appreciation of the value of language.

assessment_rubric.indicator: intonation, rhythm and pacing) in oral expression

assessment_rubric.approaches: Makes a few errors at times that interfere with communication to a limited extent.

assessment_rubric.indicator: Ability to respond to questions and prompts in oral interactions

assessment_rubric.approaches: The learner responds to most of the questions and prompts to show comprehension and engagement
assessment_rubric.below: The learner responds to very few questions and prompts to show comprehension and engagement

assessment_rubric.indicator: Ability to employ gestures and facial expressions to enhance oral interactions

assessment_rubric.meets: The learner employs appropriate gestures and facial expressions to complement oral expressions.
assessment_rubric.approaches: The learner employs most of the gestures and facial expressions to complement oral expressions.
assessment_rubric.below: The learner employs very few gestures and facial expressions to complement oral expressions.

assessment_rubric.indicator: Ability to display willingness to participate in oral interactions
assessment_rubric.exceeds: The learner is always willing to participate in meaningful oral interactions with people in their surroundings. Encourages others to engage in oral interactions.
assessment_rubric.meets: The learner is always willing to participate in meaningful oral interactions with people in their surroundings.
assessment_rubric.approaches: The learner is at times hesitant to participate in meaningful oral interactions with people in their surroundings.
assessment_rubric.below: The learner is mostly hesitant to participate in meaningful oral interactions with people in their surroundings.

substrands.name: Oral Expression Nuclear Family
learning_outcomes: use varied vocabulary when speaking
employ fluency in verbal
express enthusiasm in oral communication.

ask and give information in oral interactions

links_to_other_areas: The concept of creating a shopping list is linked to financial literacy in Business Studies under Pre-technical Studies.

learning_experiences: write down dictated simple vocabulary of seasons (le printemps, l’été, l’autumn, l’hiver)
rearrange letters to make words
fill crosswords and word puzzles with vocabulary of clothing ((un pull, blouson, pantalon, short, T-shirt, cardigan, une robe, chemise; des gants, chaussures, chaussettes, manteau, )
fill gaps in simple dialogues using simple vocabulary of weather patterns (il fait beau ... /mauvais, il pleut, il y a du vent, il fait nuageux...)
make sentences from jumbled words to practice word order
use picture writing prompts to write about seasons and related weather patterns and clothing
inquiry_questions: How do you distinguish between seasons?
core_competencies: • Critical Thinking and Problem Solving: as learners think critically when filling crosswords and word puzzles
values: Values Unity: as learners work in groups to fill crosswords and puzzles Pertinent and Contemporary Issues Disaster Risk Reduction: as learners share on the adverse effects of some weather patterns Link to other Learning Areas: The concept of vocabulary on weather patterns is related with the concept of weather and climate in Geography under Social Studies.

substrands.name: Guided Writing In the neighborhood
learning_outcomes: write common words with correct orthography
create simple sentences using correct structures
appreciate the role of writing in interactive communication contexts
learning_experiences: rearrange letters to make words on vocabulary of places in the neighbourhood in small groups
fill crosswords and word puzzles with vocabulary on the neighbourhood

fill gaps in simple dialogues using simple vocabulary of locating (à travers, en face de, à côté de, derrière, près de) and areas in the neighbourhood (la boutique, le marché, l’église, la boulangerie, la mosquée, supermarché,)
make sentences from jumbled words to indicate location of a place
write down dictated simple vocabulary in locating areas and facilities in the neighbourhood
use picture writing prompts to write simple texts
inquiry_questions: How do you find your way to unknown places?
core_competencies: Critical Thinking and Problem Solving: as learners fill crosswords and word puzzles
values: Unity: As learners work in groups to fill crosswords and puzzles
pertinent_issues: Safety: As learners are instructed on where to place different items in class
